system.description:
You cup your hands and scream through the opening on the other end. All creatures that can hear you in a 30-foot cone originating from you must make a Wisdom Saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this Jutsu's effect.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist most of this jutsu’s effects but becomes Deafened until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creature takes 4d6 psychic damage and affected creature makes their Concentration check at disadvantage.

Critical Failure: Same as failure but affected creature takes 4d8 psychic damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d6 or 1d8 and the size of the cone by 5 feet.
